headline: Bayern had 64.7% of the ball, 750 passes and 210 successful final-third passes to Lille's 49, yet only 0.25 xG from open play; Lille made 2.06 open-play xG on 35% possession and won 2-1 with two goals in four second-half minutes.

tactical_change.after: no formation change in either source
tactical_change.trigger: the second-half shift: Lille came out after half-time 0-1 down; Ueda had a goal ruled out by VAR (foul on Kimmich after Upamecano's careless back-header) just after the restart. Kompany's triple change at 76' (Binder, Díaz, Musiala) came while 1-2 down.
tactical_change.effect: Bayern's xG fell from 1.00 in the first half (6 shots, 5 on target) to 0.20 in the second (6 shots, 2 on target); Lille's rose from 0.57 to 1.55. BBC match momentum gave Lille the most threat in 23 of the 30 minutes from 46' to 75', including 16 straight minutes 58'-73' in which both Lille goals came. After Kompany's 76' triple change Bayern had the most threat in 17 of the last 20 minutes but managed 4 shots, 0 on target, 0.15 xG.

best_player.name: Ayase Ueda
best_player.why: Scout's pick. Scored the 62' equaliser, had a goal ruled out by VAR and was denied one-on-one at 23'; his 0.78 xG was the most of any player on the pitch. Özer (7 saves) is the runner-up, but his saves were mostly low-value shots (goals prevented +0.07).
best_player.source: data/research/scrape_2bdb88d6d53b.json (ESPN player stats, Ueda row: TCH 23, G 1, A 0, xG 0.78, xA 0.04, SOG 2, SHOT 4); ESPN match page Match Leaders 'Total Shots 4 A. Ueda 2 SOG, 0.78 xG' (data/research/scrape_73df1d6d0fdf.json); shots_espn.json n=14 (62', xg 0.22, xgot 0.83, Goal), n=5 (23', xg 0.45, Saved); disallowed goal: ESPN commentary 'Ueda having a goal ruled out by the VAR within moments of the restart'

worst_player.name: Aleksandar Pavlović
worst_player.why: Scout's pick. Turned the rebound off Mbappé's post into his own net at 65', the goal that won the game (ESPN report: 'clumsily turning the ball into his own net', 'capitalized on Pavlovic's error'). Otherwise 2 shots worth 0.07 xG from a 90-minute attacking-midfield role. Transparent score: an error leading to a goal outweighs his 2 shots on target.
worst_player.source: data/research/scrape_2bdb88d6d53b.json (ESPN player stats, Pavlovic row: TCH 87, G 0, A 0, xG 0.07, xA 0.08, SOG 2, SHOT 2); shots_espn.json n=17 (65', Own Goal); data/research/scrape_7840828e8b86.json (ESPN report); BBC line-ups: no sub for Pavlović (90 min)

caveats: No official player ratings; best/worst are Scout's pick. BBC player-rating widget had not closed when cached (no fan averages).
Shot-map xG sums (own goal excluded) are 2.12 / 1.20 vs team totals 2.11 / 1.18 (ESPN and BBC agree on 2.11 / 1.18). Full-match xG uses the team totals; half splits use the shot map.
The ESPN shot map lists Pavlović's own goal (n=17) as a Bayern shot; analysis.py counts it as a Lille goal and excludes it from Bayern's shots (12, matching ESPN team stats).
Bayern passes: BBC 750, ESPN 754. BBC used on screen with BBC possession and final-third passes (same source).
Lille formation: ESPN 4-1-4-1, BBC 4-3-3. Not put on screen.
Disallowed Ueda goal is not in the shot map; reason from ESPN report (foul on Kimmich). No minute on screen.
Bayern absences (Kane, Olise, Neuer) are single-source (ESPN/PA report). State factually, never mocked.
Momentum counts are minutes in which BBC's 'team with most threat' was each side, not possession or shots.
Firecrawl for analysis: none extra (data-collector fetch used 4 credits: ESPN team-stats scrape 1, BBC search 2, BBC match page 1). ESPN player stats and report were free local fetches.
